name: Analog 0 - 30V Add-on (Shelly Pill)
summary: Add-on for The Pill extending its analog voltmeter to 0-30 V DC for sensors and batteries.

f.inputs: 1 analog input AN (0-30 V DC) + 2 configurable 3.3 V digital I/O (IO2, IO3)
requires: 5-Terminal Add-on (Micro USB to 5 Terminal Add-on) for connection to The Pill

extra.typical_use: 0-5 V analog sensors; 4.2/12/24 V battery monitoring

gotchas: Not standalone: needs The Pill AND the 5-Terminal Add-on (~$28 total stack)
DC 0-30 V only — not for mains or AC voltage measurement
±(2% + 5d) accuracy is coarse for battery state-of-charge on flat Li/LiFePO4 curves
IO2/IO3 are 3.3 V / 20 mA logic — cannot drive loads; use the SSR Add-on for 30 V/300 mA
0-40 °C operating range: not for unheated outdoor/garage installs in winter
best_for: Monitoring a 12/24 V battery bank or a 0-5 V analog sensor from The Pill
